# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** pupil  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a small, dark, and gloomy face with black eyes. His appearance suggests he could be a fairly pleasant boy if his sullen exterior were penetrated.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)_

## Personality

Anthony is cheeky, sullen, and disdainful, often walking with an impertinent swagger. He displays defiant hostility and shamelessness toward his teacher, resisting her attempts to win his regard. Despite his cold and stubborn demeanor, he is a clever young boy who is capable of showing emotion when pushed or distressed.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_

## History

Anthony Tulk, an orphaned nephew of Timothy Cotton, was taken in by Mrs. Laurence Tulk and enrolled in Nell Harcourt's school. From his arrival, he showed open hostility, sullenness, and contempt toward Nell. During one school day, he poured the remaining water from his slate bottle down Aurelia Clay's neck, after which Nell kept him inside during recess to lecture him on gentlemanly behavior, though he left with a contemptuous whistle. While he rarely disobeyed outright, he maintained a disdainful attitude that distressed Nell. On a day when Nell was in a sharp mood, Anthony strutted to his desk with an impertinent swagger, whispered and grinned, and continued to whisper when the rest of the class sat in terrified silence. After meeting Nell's gaze without shame, he received a sharp punishment with a pointer until his defiance broke and he wept. When Nell later resigned, Anthony vented his distress by engaging in two deliberate, unprovoked fights with other boys on his way home.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P21](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0021), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
